title: C26 arm B: fade a take-out that closes back inside within 1h (pre-registered)

what.name: Held level
what.value_plain: 15m pivot = highest high (lowest low) of +-16 bars, pulled back >= 0.8%, retested within 0.4% without breaking, pivot <= 72h old; decision 1h after the retest
what.label: OURS

what.name: Signal
what.value_plain: the level is taken out, then a 15m close comes back inside within 4 bars
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 0.10% per round trip (Binance taker x2, backtest/fees.py); slippage and funding not modelled
what.label: SOURCED

how: Rules fixed in C26_PRE_REG.md (commit 21fbba6b) before the run; run once with c26_arms.py.
window: 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-31, split 2022-01..2024-06 vs 2024-07..now (whole history was read: a seen-period check, not a sealed test)
why: About 70% of take-outs do close back inside, but the move after is small (median 0.1-0.4% in 24h).
The wick stop is hit before the 1% target too often; fees finish it.
Replay R = net % divided by the stop distance of that trade.

examples.title: Trade replay (every trade, in time order)
examples.caption: Distance from the entry in %; up is in favour of the trade. No prices.
